# Local UI Regression Checklist

## Build Information
- Branch:
- Build date:
- Tester:

## 1. Environment
- [ ] Docker stack starts successfully
- [ ] Frontend reachable locally
- [ ] Gateway reachable locally
- [ ] Required seed data available

## 2. Core User Flows
- [ ] Sign up / login / logout
- [ ] Browse products by category
- [ ] Search product
- [ ] Product detail page
- [ ] Add to cart
- [ ] Checkout
- [ ] View purchase history

## 3. Admin Flows
- [ ] Product management
- [ ] Promotion management
- [ ] Order management
- [ ] Customer management
- [ ] Report dashboards

## 4. UI State Checks
- [ ] Loading states
- [ ] Empty states
- [ ] Validation errors
- [ ] API failure handling

## 5. Browser/Responsive
- [ ] Desktop layout
- [ ] Mobile layout
- [ ] Main supported browser checks

## 6. Evidence
- [ ] Screenshots attached
- [ ] Console/network errors reviewed
- [ ] Defects recorded (if any)
